title: BOS-1061 Repo settings surfaces a mapping the caller is not a member of

scenes.title: a mapping naming an organization the caller cannot see is called out

steps.caption: Press [r] to open the repository list
Press [enter] to open the selected repo's settings

steps.waitFor: You are not a member of
steps.caption: The membership refusal is on screen

expect.label: the refusal sits next to the setting that caused it

expect.text: You are not a member of
expect.label: the cross-organization mapping is surfaced, not silent
the refusal names the organization it is about

steps.caption: This repo is mapped to an organization absent from ListOrganizations for this caller. Without this line the field would render a bare id or fall back to Personal, and the user would lose their web-UI sessions with nothing on screen explaining why. The plan's open question resolved this to the repo settings view: proximity to the cause, which is also the only place that can fix it.
